name: compare
description: Every store's price for one product across Prisjakt and PriceRunner, cheapest first by total (price + shipping) when shipping is known, else price; offers the site reports sold out come last. The same store on both sites is one row with both prices in seen_on. Also cheapest (new) and cheapest_secondhand (used/refurbished), both skipping sold-out offers unless nothing else is listed, cheapest_in_stock (new, reported in stock), Prisjakt's price history (lowest new price per day; 30/90-day and all-time lows) and a verdict on the cheapest price. With only one site known the other is looked up by name; not found = one site only.

arguments.name: in_stock_only
arguments.desc: List only offers the site reports in stock. Default false.

arguments.name: include_used
arguments.desc: Also list used and refurbished offers. Default false: new only (unknown condition counts as new). cheapest_secondhand is reported either way.

arguments.name: product
arguments.desc: A key from search ('prisjakt:123+pricerunner:456'), a Prisjakt or PriceRunner product page URL, or a plain product name (the first search result is used).

name: search
description: Search Prisjakt and PriceRunner at once. Returns products with both sites' listings merged when they are the same model: key (pass to compare), name, brand, category, image, rating, each site's lowest price, offer count and url (sources), how the sites were tied (match: gtin/name, null for one site) and the cheapest site. errors lists a site that failed; the other's results still come back.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Product to look for, e.g. 'airpods pro 2', 'iphone 16 128gb', 'samsung qe55q80d'. Model names and numbers work best.

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: Sites to search, default both: ['prisjakt'], ['pricerunner'] or both.
